record_notes.DCP-LETT-1832: Explicit accepted primary full-source reading reused after matching note, ledger and source hashes. February 23, 1856 exact Calcutta ALS; five complete blocks, twenty-four footnotes, annotations, bibliography, raw half MathML and actual labelled Gallus head drawing read. Previous brief letter got to post office, not evidence it reached Darwin. Four printed appeal copies now sent versus rough proof sent previous mail; their exact identification as salary memorial is apparatus inference and eventual1864 pension is later. February20 anniversary walk is an actual prior event, proposed Calcutta gardens future. Gallus varius first living observation includes a pale bluish-lake comb, red/yellow throat regions and blue tip labelled in figure; hybrid Gallus oeneus claim remains Blyth report. Pigeon procurement and ten-pound proposal, macaw/marmoset barter and prices remain negotiations, not completed shipments. Complaint about Bartlett is Blyth allegation, no independent finding. P3 explicitly answers missing December16 Darwin letter, cannot recall exact authority for Oman asses or red-deer infertility. Wild dog is now dead with skin/skeleton preparation ongoing; earlier identification revised after Hodgson examination. Canine-hybrid experiment advocates matched sibling controls, not completed comparative results. P4 half-bred Sonneratii is 1/2, not twelve birds; observed repeated infertile eggs qualified by possible individual fertility differences. Coracias skins procured by Blyth, not Darwin. Northern/southern bird comparisons and tropical gaps qualified; Darwin consultation note is undated. Docket12 is sequence marker only.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1833: Explicit accepted primary full-source reading reused after matching note, ledger and source hashes. record_notes.DCP-LETT-1845: Explicit accepted primary full-source reading reused after matching note, ledger and source hashes. Undated thirteen-page signed memorandum, circa March22,1856. Seven retained body blocks, all thirty-two notes, bibliography, annotations, actual musk-ox sketch and two MathML halves read. P4 March22 separates earlier composition; ending implies completion later. Single XML day does not make all sections exactly March22. Explicit Darwin top annotation Received May6/56 is receipt evidence, separate from composition, reading completion and sequence13. Annobon fowl claim questioned after reading French article; purported French quotation is not exact published wording according to apparatus. Proceedings batch just received by Blyth, not Darwin. Owen musk-ox naming criticised with sketch drawn from memory of a printed portrait, not a live sighting. Pigeon varieties acquired by Blyth, sending and breeding/crossing still intended. Historic origin inferred from rump colour/names/textual absence, not proven. P3 half-way feathering and P4 half-dozen repetitions are genuine MathML, not12. Four attempted esplanade observations yielded no flock, so dark-feet contrast explicitly deferred. P5 now prefers African wild-ass origin, revising earlier Arabian emphasis; newly prepared paper later published1859 is not necessarily the same final version available to Darwin in1856. P7 is quoted March13 newspaper claim with Blyth comment, not independent survey or new Darwin voice.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1849: Explicit accepted primary full-source reading reused after matching note, ledger and source hashes. Undated eight-page memorandum, supplied April3,1856 solely from Darwin pencil annotation; distinguish this from an explicit receipt label. All twenty-one retained blocks, eight notes, bibliography, separate annotations and raw opening layout read. P1 Notes heading not letter prose for future content. P2 identifies David Scott manuscript copy, difficult left-handed writing after injury. P3–20 interleave Scott quotation and Blyth inserted observations; neither is Darwin voice. English/Hindustani list is broken into raw paragraphs with literal diag/ramme tokens and no table/image; matching may need manuscript layout, especially Gahu and unknown/illegible names. P15 two literal Unicode halves are already correct, not MathML. P3 now personally reports wild pigeons have pink feet, updating1845 deferred dark-foot conjecture; typical-coloured bald-pates also obtained, revising earlier limitation. Scott reports from Hansi and has not been stationed at Delhi/Lucknow; not universal coverage of those cities. Blyth finds local carriers better than Scott description and distinguishes differently patterned breeds despite naming overlap. P21 all domestic pigeons from livia/intermedia is expressly his judgment based on voice/pairing, and guinea-fowl historical trade continuity is his inference from Browne, not independent proof. Proposed foreign correspondents/procurement remain requests. Docket14 and other Darwin comparative notes are separate undated layer.
